final: WITH rating_stats AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) as avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) as per_day_price FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(per_day_price) as mean_per_day_price FROM rating_stats) SELECT rs.rating, rs.avg_replacement_cost, rs.per_day_price, rs.per_day_price / om.mean_per_day_price as price_ratio FROM rating_stats rs CROSS JOIN overall_mean om ORDER BY rs.rating
